<function=python>

col_starts_lower = [14, 21, 28, 35, 42]
ci = 0
cs = col_starts_lower[ci]

# Record current symbol at position 0
pattern = []
for r in range(52, 57):
    row = []
    for c in range(cs + 1, cs + 6):
        ch = ascii_lines[r][c]
        row.append('B' if ch != 'P' else '.')
    pattern.append(''.join(row))
print(f"Position 0 start: {'|'.join(pattern)}")

# Press UP 6 times and record
for i in range(6):
    action(['UP'])
    ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    pattern = []
    for r in range(52, 57):
        row = []
        for c in range(cs + 1, cs + 6):
            ch = ascii_lines[r][c]
            row.append('B' if ch != 'P' else '.')
        pattern.append(''.join(row))
    print(f"Position 0 UP {i+1}: {'|'.join(pattern)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
